gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Comic Relief draws every stroke at a single thickness, with bowls left unfinished on one side, while Sawarabi Mincho thins its hairlines only slightly. A refined text serif, gentle going.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-sedan: Sedan reads bookish and authoritative, with mellow stroke weights and terminals held far from the letter body, under Comic Relief's bold, unshaded heading. Larger headings suit it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-sedan-sc: Sedan SC reads literary and bookish, its broad openings and mild thicks swelling gently along each curve beneath Comic Relief's steady, pressure-even heading. Its quiet generosity is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-shippori-mincho: Chunky, unshaded and a bit lopsided in the bowls: that is Comic Relief up top. Shippori Mincho brings modest contrast and generous openings in every curve, and that classic literary polish is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-shippori-mincho-b: Blunt, bold and tube-like, Comic Relief has joins no thinner than its stems. And Shippori Mincho B1 adds a wide-open crescent c with sturdy hairlines, so a small heading would lose that punch.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-spectral: Spectral leads with a bookish, classic hand, its stems a touch heavier than the crossbars and its shoulders thickening gently. And Comic Relief overhead keeps a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-spectral-sc: Spectral SC reads literary and bookish, with sturdy hairlines beside moderate stems and wide mouths on its round forms, smoothing the pace of a line. Comic Relief sits above it, monoline and commanding.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-stix-two-text: Editorial in mood, STIX Two Text has a soft thick-thin shift and terminals pulled back from the curves. But Comic Relief does bold, one-weight emphasis best, while the body does traditional polish.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tai-heritage-pro: Comic Relief brings bold, commanding shapes where even the n arches are as thick as the stems. And Tai Heritage Pro follows with dignified, editorial lines, its diagonals slightly lighter than its verticals.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-taviraj: Taviraj reads bookish and editorial, a text serif with a generous gap where each curve ends and medium contrast in its strokes. And Comic Relief's tubing-like loops make the difference between them its strongest quality.
